goal: Report sandbox migration-ledger drift the same way production drift is reported (#2986), and stop the grok reviewer returning no verdict on large migrations (#2492). Read-only throughout: no migration, no database write, no production or sandbox mutation.
dispatcher: Owner Albert Hazan: resolve through to production all open non-orchestrator GitHub issues in this repo
prohibited_actions: No database write of any kind, including the sandbox: the migrations for #2986 were already applied on 2026-09-15 and must not be re-applied.
No new migration, no terraform or terragrunt apply, no mutating production gcloud command.
No secret value in any commit, log, command argument or chat; DB_*_SANDBOX is referenced by name only.
Do not disable, bypass or weaken any safety gate, and do not hand-edit a shared coordination ref.
assumptions: The two ledger reads this work performs are one constant SELECT each over the Supabase Management API, made by the checker at RUNTIME, not database work performed by this contract; db_reads is therefore empty as repo-maintenance requires.

The sandbox is reachable by project ref through the Supabase Management API with the existing SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN, so no new DB_*_SANDBOX repository secret is required. Verified by a live read-only query before any code was written.
The sandbox is owed a derived SUBSET of the merged migration tree, because it was seeded from a structure dump; comparing the whole tree would report ~695 false gaps on the first run.
ai-grok-review's --max-turns is a per-call runtime bound, so the caller may size it without changing popcre/ai-devops.
stop_conditions: Stop if the work would require any write to the sandbox or production database.
Stop if the fix for #2492 can only be made in popcre/ai-devops; report the routing instead of making a blind cross-repo change.
Stop if the governed reviewer gate cannot be satisfied; never bypass it.
